name: Compute Cluster S61: Regression, Hedge Ratio & Spread
description: Tests: linear_fit(window). OLS slope (hedge ratio), intercept, residual (spread). Detrending and spread construction for pairs trading.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S61: Linear Fit (Rolling OLS)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c

# === LINEAR FIT: SPY = slope * QQQ + intercept ===
fit = linear_fit(window=120)(ref_close, close)
spread = fit.residual
hedge = fit.slope
intcpt = fit.intercept

# === Z-SCORE THE SPREAD ===
spread_z = zscore(window=20)(spread)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='OLS Spread (Residual)',
    category='Regression',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread)

xy_lines(
    title='Spread Z-Score',
    category='Regression',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread_z)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Hedge Ratio (Slope)',
    category='Regression',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hedge Ratio', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=hedge)
